_comment: OUR ADJUDICATION of this product's passing rows, from the v3.2 coffee fitness audit — the one where every pass_evidenced row in a 100-product sample was read individually against its FULL untruncated evidence. Kept beside the capture, not inside it, so the .gz stays a faithful record of what the store served. Extracted mechanically from experiments/v3-2/verdicts.json by experiments/v3-3/build_fixture.mjs; never hand-typed.

auditedRows.label: Whole bean option is listed and purchasable
auditedRows.why: "Whole Bean" heads an explicit grind list separate from the size option.

auditedRows.label: Espresso grind option is listed and purchasable
auditedRows.why: "Fine (Espresso)" names an espresso grind size directly.

auditedRows.label: Filter grind option is listed and purchasable
auditedRows.why: "Medium Coarse (Chemex / Cone Filter)" is a filter grind size; "Medium (Pour Over / Auto Drip)" corroborates.

auditedRows.label: A weight or measurement is stated in readable text
auditedRows.why: The quoted variant option "2 lb bag." is one of the product's own sizes (alongside 310 g and 5 lb).

auditedRows.label: A dispatch or delivery window is stated
auditedRows.why: "All orders are processed within 2-3 business days" states a real dispatch window, with the weekend/holiday caveat attached.
